title: Shopify pet-products dropshipping store advertised on TikTok

source.text: A Shopify dropshipping store selling pet products advertised on TikTok. Launch country US, budget $1,500, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug pet-dropshipping.

customer: US dog and cat owners who discover and impulse-buy pet gadgets on TikTok
solution: A Shopify store reselling trending pet products shipped directly by third-party suppliers (dropshipping), with traffic bought through TikTok ads
assumptions: Products are generic pet gadgets (slicker brushes, lick mats, water fountains) sourced from China-based suppliers via DSers, Zendrop or CJ
Selling price about USD 29.99 per order, i.e. 2.5-3x landed cost, the usual dropshipping markup
Landed cost about USD 16 per order: product 8 + shipping 5 + duty and brokerage 3 (de minimis ended 2025-08-29)
The founder has no prior e-commerce or paid-ads experience and no audience
Interest is stated as side income, not a passion for pets
No questions were asked (user said 'just go')
